# tt-emule known regression failures.

# Format: one gtest filter expression per line. Wildcards permitted
# (e.g. `Fixture.*`). Comments start with `#`; blank lines are ignored.

# Stale entries (listed here but matching no test in the run) cause CI to fail.
# Newly-passing entries (listed here but the test now passes) also cause CI to
# fail, signalling that someone fixed something and this file should be updated.
#
# See KNOWN_ISSUES.md for the underlying root-cause analysis. Section numbers
# below refer to that document.
